microphone.title: Microphone access
microphone.body: Project Recall needs microphone access to record audio you explicitly start.
microphone.denied: Microphone permission was denied. Enable it in Settings to record.

camera.title: Camera access
camera.body: Camera access lets you attach photos to the current recording.
camera.denied: Camera permission was denied. Enable it in Settings to take photos.

photos.title: Photos & videos
photos.body: We only access items you explicitly pick.
photos.denied: Photo access was denied. Enable it in Settings to attach media.

notifications.title: Recording notification
notifications.body: A persistent notification shows while recording so you always know when the microphone is active.
